_about: Facts the documents state that no code defines (instrument, archive, history), each with its source. The registry includes them as the namespace facts (tools/registry.py).

bruce_aperture_mm.source: HDAP service documentation (dc.g-vo.org/lswscans/res/positions/q/info): Bruce telescope, focal length 2000 mm at f/5

lostlight_aperture_pref_m.source: Project Lost Light call (lostlightproject.netlify.app, read 2026-10-31): "preferably obtained with telescopes of at least 0.8 m aperture"

villarroel2026a_catalogue_arcsec.source: Villarroel et al. (2026a), MNRAS 546, staf1158 (arXiv:2510.17907, Sec. 3.1, read 2026-10-31), Sample A of Zwicky Transient Facility alerts: all sources within 1.5 arcseconds from a catalogued object were discarded

villarroel2026a_asteroid_arcsec.source: Villarroel et al. (2026a), MNRAS 546, staf1158 (arXiv:2510.17907, Sec. 3.1, read 2026-10-31), Sample A of Zwicky Transient Facility alerts: sources within 10 arcseconds of catalogued asteroids removed

villarroel2026a_ebv_max.source: Villarroel et al. (2026a), MNRAS 546, staf1158 (arXiv:2510.17907, Sec. 3.1, read 2026-10-31), Sample A of Zwicky Transient Facility alerts: fields with a Galactic extinction higher than E(B - V) = 0.3 mag excluded

bruce_focal_mm.source: HDAP service documentation: Bruce telescope, effective focal length 2000 mm

bruce_scale_arcsec_per_mm.source: HDAP service documentation: Bruce telescope, scale 103 arcsec/mm

scan_px_per_mm.source: HDAP service documentation: 100 pixels per millimetre (200 optical)

plate_cm_short.source: HDAP service documentation: Bruce plates 24x30 cm or 30x30 cm

plate_cm_long.source: HDAP service documentation: Bruce plates 24x30 cm or 30x30 cm

villarroel2021_sources.source: Villarroel et al. (2021), Scientific Reports 11, 12794: nine simultaneously occurring transients on a POSS-I plate of 12 April 1950

villarroel2025_sigma.source: Villarroel et al. (2025), PASP 137, 104504, Section 8: the detection after correcting for survey coverage, which Villarroel (2026, The VASCO network, 11 July 2026, read in full 2026-10-31) names as the benchmark for power: "the 7.6σ detection after correcting for survey coverage, not the idealized 22σ result"

zenodo_quota_gb.source: Zenodo help, Manage files (help.zenodo.org/docs/deposit/manage-files, read 2026-10-30): 'If you would like to upload up to 200GB of data, please see Manage storage quota'

zenodo_files_per_record.source: Zenodo help, Manage files (read 2026-10-30): 'You can upload up to a 100 files and a total volume of 50GB'; the quota increase raises the volume, not the file count

team_years.source: Donal's edit of the pre-registration draft, 1 November 2026: over 15 years' experience

poss_transients_per_plate.source: Villarroel et al. (2025), PASP 137, 104504 (doi:10.1088/1538-3873/ae0afe, read 2026-11-02): 'a sample of 106,339 transients', '635 unique photographic plates', 'which average 167 transients per plate'

spent_to_date_usd.source: AWS Cost Explorer, unblended cost before credits and refunds, tax included, this study's days from the Heidelberg pilot (27 October 2026) to 8 November 2026: $133.19, read 9 November 2026 (November's figures still marked estimated by AWS)

costs_rerun_factor.source: Donal's decision (1 November 2026): the AWS estimate requested twice over, to allow reruns after technical failures

cc_by_version.source: LICENSE-data: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)

solano_detect_thresh.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: SExtractor DETECT_THRESH 5

solano_snr.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: SNR_WIN > 30

solano_star_arcsec.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: USNO-B1.0 stars within 90 arcsec

solano_spread_model.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: SPREAD_MODEL > -0.002

solano_fwhm_px.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: 2 < FWHM < 7 pixels

solano_elong.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: ELONGATION < 1.3

solano_counterpart_arcsec.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: no Gaia EDR3 or Pan-STARRS DR2 source within 5 arcsec

solano_pm_arcmin.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: Gaia within 3 arcmin moved to the plate epoch

solano_skybot_arcmin.source: Solano et al. (2022), MNRAS 515, 1380 (arXiv 2206.00907), as tabulated step by step in notes/selection_vs_solano.md: SkyBoT, 1 arcmin

massive_asteroids.source: the ephemeris integrates the planets and the 16 most massive asteroids (JPL's sb441-n16 kernel, used by ASSIST; heidelberg/asteroid_ephem_024.py)

catalogue_revision.source: the Heidelberg plate catalogue, res/plattenkatalog.csv in GAVO's SVN at revision 9476 (pinned in heidelberg/inputs.sha256)

logbook_s.source: twelve plates' start and end in the catalogue against the scanned observation logbooks (UB Heidelberg): within 30 s (heidelberg/tests/logbook.py)

clock_corr_1905_s.source: the 1905 logbook's clock correction, about 25 s (the table at the front of volume 1), left out of the comparison

gavo_offset_h.source: GAVO's dateObs is 12 hours early on plates whose exposure crosses 0 h UT (notes/log.md, 2026-10-30; heidelberg/tests/sample_numbers.py)

price_r7i_4xlarge_h.source: an r7i.4xlarge's on-demand price per hour (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

price_c7i_16xlarge_h.source: a c7i.16xlarge's on-demand price per hour (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

price_r7i_8xlarge_h.source: an r7i.8xlarge's on-demand price per hour (USD; 32 vCPU, 256 GiB): AWS's public price data for EU (Stockholm), Linux (b0.p.awsstatic.com, ec2-ondemand-without-sec-sel), fetched 2026-10-31, which gives the r7i.4xlarge, r7i.16xlarge, and c7i.16xlarge prices recorded here

price_r7i_16xlarge_h.source: an r7i.16xlarge's on-demand price per hour (USD; 64 vCPU, 512 GiB): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-31 with aws pricing get-products

price_s3_gb_month.source: S3 standard storage per GB-month (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

price_egress_gb.source: data transfer out to the internet per GB (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

tuning_select_h.source: the first tuning selection's time on one r7i.4xlarge for the 46 tuning pairs, when the catalogue services answered slowly (the job's times on S3; notes/g3_factsheet.md)

gavo_wrong_centres.source: GAVO's listed plate centres are wrong on about a third of the plates in this range of plate numbers (review W5 and the solved centres, notes/log.md, 2026-10-30)

drand_chain.source: the hash of drand's quicknet chain, which the timelock encrypts to: drand quicknet's chain information, https://api.drand.sh/52db9ba70e0cc0f6eaf7803dd07447a1f5477735fd3f661792ba94600c84e971/info (also in tools/tlock's README)

drand_genesis_s.source: quicknet's genesis time (Unix seconds): drand quicknet's chain information, https://api.drand.sh/52db9ba70e0cc0f6eaf7803dd07447a1f5477735fd3f661792ba94600c84e971/info (also in tools/tlock's README)

drand_period_s.source: quicknet's round period (seconds): drand quicknet's chain information, https://api.drand.sh/52db9ba70e0cc0f6eaf7803dd07447a1f5477735fd3f661792ba94600c84e971/info (also in tools/tlock's README)

gauss_k.source: the Gaussian gravitational constant (AU^1.5 per day; IAU 1976 System of Astronomical Constants)

obliquity_j2000_arcsec.source: the mean obliquity of the ecliptic at J2000 (arcsec; IAU 1976, as the Minor Planet Center's elements use)

c_au_day.source: the speed of light in AU per day (299,792.458 km/s over the IAU 2012 astronomical unit)

au_km.source: the astronomical unit in km (IAU 2012 Resolution B2)

gmst_1982.source: Greenwich mean sidereal time (deg) = c0 + c1 d + c2 T^2, d days and T centuries from J2000 (IAU 1982 model; Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, 12.4)

hg_phase.source: the H-G magnitude system's phase functions, exp(-A1 tan(a/2)^B1) and exp(-A2 tan(a/2)^B2): A1, B1, A2, B2 (Bowell et al. 1989, Asteroids II)

hg_default_g.source: the slope parameter G taken when an orbit has none (Bowell et al. 1989; the Minor Planet Center's default)

price_s3_it_ia_gb_month.source: S3 Intelligent-Tiering, Infrequent Access tier, per GB-month (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

price_s3_it_aia_gb_month.source: S3 Intelligent-Tiering, Archive Instant Access tier, per GB-month (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

price_s3_it_monitor_1000.source: S3 Intelligent-Tiering's monitoring, per 1,000 objects per month (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

price_s3_it_transition_1000.source: S3 lifecycle transitions to Intelligent-Tiering, per 1,000 objects (USD): AWS's price list for eu-north-1 (Stockholm), fetched 2026-10-30 with aws pricing get-products

s3_it_days.source: S3 Intelligent-Tiering moves an object not read for this many days to the Infrequent Access tier, and then to Archive Instant Access (AWS's S3 documentation, storage classes)

s3_price_standard_gb_month.source: S3 Standard storage, USD per GB-month: AWS's price list for Amazon S3 in eu-north-1 (EU, Stockholm), published 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-01 (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonS3/current/eu-north-1/index.json)

s3_price_sia_gb_month.source: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access storage, USD per GB-month: AWS's price list for Amazon S3 in eu-north-1 (EU, Stockholm), published 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-01 (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonS3/current/eu-north-1/index.json)

s3_price_sia_retrieval_gb.source: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access retrieval, USD per GB: AWS's price list for Amazon S3 in eu-north-1 (EU, Stockholm), published 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-01 (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonS3/current/eu-north-1/index.json)

s3_price_gir_gb_month.source: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval storage, USD per GB-month: AWS's price list for Amazon S3 in eu-north-1 (EU, Stockholm), published 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-01 (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonS3/current/eu-north-1/index.json)

s3_price_gir_retrieval_gb.source: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval retrieval, USD per GB: AWS's price list for Amazon S3 in eu-north-1 (EU, Stockholm), published 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-01 (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonS3/current/eu-north-1/index.json)

s3_price_gda_gb_month.source: S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage, USD per GB-month: AWS's price list for Amazon S3 in eu-north-1 (published 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-01) has no line for it, but gives this price for the Intelligent-Tiering Deep Archive Access tier; third-party tables (costgoat.com/pricing/amazon-s3, read 2026-11-01) give the same for Glacier Deep Archive in EU (Stockholm)

s3_price_gda_bulk_gb.source: S3 Glacier Deep Archive bulk retrieval (within 48 hours), USD per GB: AWS's price list for Amazon S3 in eu-north-1 (EU, Stockholm), published 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-01

costs_restore_days.source: the scans are restored from Deep Archive once, for part one (measuring and the asteroid clock), and the restored copies kept this many days, billed as S3 Standard

costs_storage_months.source: the scan copies and products kept from the copy (November 2026) to the report (by mid-October 2027), as the timeline states
